args.content:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Organizes the Downloads folder into categorized subdirectories.
.DESCRIPTION
    Scans the Downloads folder (or specified path) and moves files into organized
    subfolders based on extension, preserving existing folders and avoiding overwriting.
.PARAMETER Path
    Target directory path. Defaults to $HOME\Downloads.
.PARAMETER WhatIf
    Simulate the organization without moving files.
#>

[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess=$true)]
param (
    [string]$TargetFolder = "$HOME\Downloads",
    [switch]$WhatIfMode = $false
)

if (-not (Test-Path -Path $TargetFolder)) {
    Write-Error "Folder '$TargetFolder' does not exist."
    return
}

# Category extension dictionary
$Categories = @{
    "Documents"               = @(".pdf", ".doc", ".docx", ".txt", ".rtf", ".odt", ".pages", ".md", ".tex", ".epub", ".mobi")
    "Spreadsheets"            = @(".xls", ".xlsx", ".csv", ".ods", ".numbers", ".tsv")
    "Presentations"           = @(".ppt", ".pptx", ".key", ".odp")
    "Images"                  = @(".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".bmp", ".svg", ".webp", ".tiff", ".tif", ".heic", ".ico", ".raw", ".psd", ".ai")
    "Audio"                   = @(".mp3", ".wav", ".flac", ".aac", ".ogg", ".m4a", ".wma", ".mid", ".midi")
    "Videos"                  = @(".mp4", ".mkv", ".mov", ".avi", ".webm", ".wmv", ".flv", ".m4v", ".3gp")
    "Archives"                = @(".zip", ".rar", ".7z", ".tar", ".gz", ".bz2", ".xz", ".iso", ".cab")
    "Installers & Executables"= @(".exe", ".msi", ".pkg", ".deb", ".rpm", ".appimage")
    "Code & Data"             = @(".py", ".js", ".ts", ".html", ".css", ".json", ".xml", ".sql", ".java", ".cpp", ".c", ".h", ".cs", ".php", ".ps1", ".bat", ".sh", ".yaml", ".yml")
    "Design & 3D"             = @(".stl", ".obj", ".blend", ".step", ".stp", ".dwg", ".dxf", ".fbx")
    "Fonts"                   = @(".ttf", ".otf", ".woff", ".woff2")
}

$SkipExt = @(".crdownload", ".tmp", ".part", ".download")

Write-Host "Organizing files in: $TargetFolder" -ForegroundColor Cyan
if ($WhatIfMode) {
    Write-Host "=== WHAT-IF MODE (No files will actually be moved) ===" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $TargetFolder -File -Force | Where-Object { -not $_.Name.StartsWith(".") }
$counts = @{}
$skipped = 0

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $ext = $file.Extension.ToLower()

    if ($SkipExt -contains $ext) {
        Write-Host "Skipping partial download: $($file.Name)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        $skipped++
        continue
    }

    $targetCategory = "Other Files"
    foreach ($category in $Categories.Keys) {
        if ($Categories[$category] -contains $ext) {
            $targetCategory = $category
            break
        }
    }

    $categoryDir = Join-Path -Path $TargetFolder -ChildPath $targetCategory

    # Destination filename collision handling
    $targetFilePath = Join-Path -Path $categoryDir -ChildPath $file.Name
    $counter = 1
    $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($file.Name)
    
    while (Test-Path -Path $targetFilePath) {
        $newFileName = "${baseName}_${counter}${ext}"
        $targetFilePath = Join-Path -Path $categoryDir -ChildPath $newFileName
        $counter++
    }

    if (-not $counts.ContainsKey($targetCategory)) {
        $counts[$targetCategory] = 0
    }
    $counts[$targetCategory]++

    if ($WhatIfMode) {
        Write-Host "[What-If] $($file.Name) -> $targetCategory\$([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($targetFilePath))" -ForegroundColor Gray
    } else {
        if (-not (Test-Path -Path $categoryDir)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $categoryDir -Force | Out-Null
        }
        Move-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetFilePath
        Write-Host "Moved: $($file.Name) -> $targetCategory\$([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($targetFilePath))" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
}

Write-Host "`n========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "ORGANIZATION SUMMARY:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$totalMoved = 0
foreach ($cat in ($counts.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
    Write-Host "  $cat : $($counts[$cat]) file(s)"
    $totalMoved += $counts[$cat]
}
Write-Host "  Skipped : $skipped file(s)"
Write-Host "Total files processed: $totalMoved"
Write-Host "========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Downloads Folder Organizer for Bash (macOS & Linux)
TARGET_DIR="${1:-$HOME/Downloads}"
DRY_RUN=0

if [ "$2" == "--dry-run" ] || [ "$1" == "--dry-run" ]; then
    DRY_RUN=1
    if [ "$1" == "--dry-run" ]; then TARGET_DIR="$HOME/Downloads"; fi
fi

if [ ! -d "$TARGET_DIR" ]; then
    echo "Error: Directory '$TARGET_DIR' does not exist."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Organizing files in: $TARGET_DIR"
if [ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "=== DRY RUN MODE (No files will be moved) ==="
fi

# Define categories and extensions
declare -A CATEGORIES
CATEGORIES["Documents"]="pdf doc docx txt rtf odt pages md tex epub mobi"
CATEGORIES["Spreadsheets"]="xls xlsx csv ods numbers tsv"
CATEGORIES["Presentations"]="ppt pptx key odp"
CATEGORIES["Images"]="jpg jpeg png gif bmp svg webp tiff tif heic ico raw psd ai"
CATEGORIES["Audio"]="mp3 wav flac aac ogg m4a wma mid midi"
CATEGORIES["Videos"]="mp4 mkv mov avi webm wmv flv m4v 3gp"
CATEGORIES["Archives"]="zip rar 7z tar gz bz2 xz iso cab tgz"
CATEGORIES["Installers_Executables"]="exe msi dmg pkg deb rpm appimage"
CATEGORIES["Code_Data"]="py js ts html css json xml sql java cpp c h cs php sh bat ps1 yaml yml"
CATEGORIES["Design_3D"]="stl obj blend step stp dwg dxf fbx"
CATEGORIES["Fonts"]="ttf otf woff woff2"

# Move files
cd "$TARGET_DIR" || exit 1

for file in *; do
    # Skip directories and hidden files
    [ -f "$file" ] || continue
    [[ "$file" == .* ]] && continue

    ext="${file##*.}"
    ext_lower="$(echo "$ext" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"

    # Skip partial downloads
    if [[ "$ext_lower" == "crdownload" || "$ext_lower" == "tmp" || "$ext_lower" == "part" || "$ext_lower" == "download" ]]; then
        echo "Skipping partial download: $file"
        continue
    fi

    target_cat="Other_Files"
    for cat in "${!CATEGORIES[@]}"; do
        for e in ${CATEGORIES[$cat]}; do
            if [ "$ext_lower" == "$e" ]; then
                target_cat="$cat"
                break 2
            fi
        done
    done

    dest_folder="$TARGET_DIR/$target_cat"
    dest_path="$dest_folder/$file"

    # Collision avoidance
    if [ -e "$dest_path" ]; then
        filename="${file%.*}"
        extension="${file##*.}"
        counter=1
        while [ -e "$dest_folder/${filename}_${counter}.${extension}" ]; do
            ((counter++))
        done
        dest_path="$dest_folder/${filename}_${counter}.${extension}"
    fi

    if [ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "[DRY-RUN] Would move: '$file' -> '$target_cat/$(basename "$dest_path")'"
    else
        mkdir -p "$dest_folder"
        mv "$file" "$dest_path"
        echo "Moved: '$file' -> '$target_cat/$(basename "$dest_path")'"
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "Organization Complete!"

Jones, because background assistant tasks are sandboxed and cannot directly execute file movements on your computer's local operating system, I have prepared everything required to organize your **625 items** strictly within your `Downloads/` directory into categorized subfolders.

All files will remain **strictly within `Downloads/`** (subfolders are created directly inside `Downloads/` such as `Downloads/Documents/`, `Downloads/Images/`, `Downloads/Videos/`, etc.), ensuring nothing is moved outside of your Downloads directory.

| **`Videos/`** | `.mp4`, `.mkv`, `.mov`, `.avi`, `.webm`, `.wmv`, `.flv`, `.m4v`, `.3gp` |
| **`Archives/`** | `.zip`, `.rar`, `.7z`, `.tar`, `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.iso`, `.7z` |
| **`Installers & Executables/`** | `.exe`, `.msi`, `.dmg`, `.pkg`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.appimage` |
| **`Code & Data/`** | `.py`, `.js`, `.ts`, `.html`, `.css`, `.json`, `.xml`, `.sql`, `.java`, `.cpp`, `.c`, `.cs`, `.sh`, `.bat`, `.ps1`, `.yaml`, `.yml` |

| **`Fonts/`** | `.ttf`, `.otf`, `.woff`, `.woff2` |
| **`Other Files/`** | Any remaining miscellaneous file extensions |

*Safety features built into the scripts:*
- **No Overwriting:** Automatically renames duplicates (e.g. `file_1.pdf`) if a file with that name already exists in the destination folder.
- **Incomplete Downloads Protected:** Skips partial/temporary files (`.crdownload`, `.part`, `.tmp`, `.download`).
- **Skips Existing Folders:** Ignores existing subdirectories so folders are not moved inside other folders.
